title: Every local-snapshot publish witnesses the storage remote
goal: CEO decision 2026-11-11 ("wire it"): the storage guard of T-CLAUDESTORAGEGUARD-1 must run without anyone remembering it. After submit, retry-main, cut and retry, local-snapshot runs the guard against origin in the publishing clone, whatever the command's result. It is advisory, as main has no gates: a finding goes to stderr and never changes the exit status or stdout; it is silent when nothing is wrong; SUSI_NO_STORAGE_GUARD=1 skips it. No scheduler and no hosting-provider feature is involved.
limitations: The harness's own submit-main and integrate paths (crates/susi-harness/src/git_governor.rs) do not start the guard: susi-harness is at its lean-core line ceiling, which only goes down without a CEO decision.
